comment: restore.c restgamestate():596 role_init() during a restore. Segment 0 saves a hero renamed "play" in the file named for "player" (gs.SAVEF). Segment 1, with !selectsaved, types "player": dorecover():797 reads the saved name "play", role_init()'s plnamesuffix() finds it generic and asks "Who are you?" under "Restoring save file...", and dorecover():893 then reads the saved name over the answer, so the hero is still "play".
